message: 立ち入ることなかれ
We're patrolling to make sure the area is safe and check whether the demon from before has shown up again.

name: Synn
message: 「So far, it doesn't look like there have been any sightings while the sun is out.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, it wouldn't be surprising if a student or teacher got hurt soon.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「At this hour, the only people wandering around campus are delinquents.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「They wouldn't hang out in a place like this.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Against a demon, they'd be the ones getting beat up instead.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like I said, they aren't here!」
Whoever it might be, once something happens, it's already too late. That's why we patrol--to stop things before they get out of hand.

name: Lolotte
message: 「I heard there are a lot of them who go around smashing school windows at night, though...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Lolo-chan. I think you'd better trade that guidebook in for the latest edition.」

name: Synn
message: 「Shh, quiet. Someone's there...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「All of a sudden?! Wait, mph-mph!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut up!」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Is someone there?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ho... hoo-hokekyo.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Are you messing around?」
And that was my best bird call, too.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn. Could that person be...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. That's Ms. Sengen'in, the student teacher.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So that's Mr. Demon?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Keep your voice down!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yours is way louder, Treasurer!」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「What are you doing over there?」
It's no use. Time to give up.

name: Synn
message: 「Good evening~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Me? I'm Ryuusei Academy's--」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Student Council President, Synn Sakura」
Guh, cut off without mercy.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Impressive as expected of a celebrity♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't tease me」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「It should be well past the time to go home. What is the Student Council President doing here at this hour?」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um, well...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Believe it or not, it's a patrol!! Actually, inside this academy there are demo--mmph!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, stop that! If you talk about us, things are gonna get complicated!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Things get more interesting the more foreshadowing you lay down」

name: Synn
message: 「No, Nanaka's right. Even if I tell her we're patrolling to exterminate Demons, I doubt I could explain it well...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And it'd be awkward if we got misunderstood over that」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「What are you whispering about over there?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, well... Actually, night patrols are also part of our Student Council activities...」
Well, will she buy it...?

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Go home right away」
Phew.

name: Synn
message: 「Please take care on your way home too, Ms. Sengen'in」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Thank you. Goodbye」
With those words, she disappeared into the darkness.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aah~~. That scared me」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How boring. I was totally banking on that teacher being the big boss leading the Demons」

name: Synn
message: 「If you blurt something like that out of nowhere, she's the one who'll get scared」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn took Lolo's joke completely seriously. The way you're talking, it's like you've already decided they're the big boss」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, no... I wouldn't go that far...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I think it's suspicious, though. A student teacher showing up out of nowhere like that」

name: Synn
message: 「Which side are you on」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I believe they are innocent」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whose side are you on!!」

name: Synn
message: 「If we end up looking suspicious instead, that'd defeat the whole purpose. Let's keep a low profile as much as possible and continue our patrol」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is it really okay to ignore their orders? They are technically a teacher, after all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It'll be fine. After all, we've got the board chairman's seal of approval!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not like we're doing anything to feel guilty about, but getting intimidated like that still makes it hard...」
Well, if we get yelled at, I'll just go talk to Ms. Helena or something.
